title: ML Pipeline & Model Serving Platformu
brief:
Bu projede, veri toplama asamasindan model deployment'a kadar end-to-end bir ML pipeline platformu insa edeceksin. Gercek dunyada Amazon SageMaker, Google Vertex AI veya Databricks'in kucuk ama fonksiyonel bir versiyonunu dusun.

Platform su asamalari kapsar: veri ingestion, feature engineering, model training, experiment tracking (MLflow), model registry, A/B testing, real-time inference API, model monitoring ve drift detection. Her asama bagimsiz calisabilir ama birlikte orkestre edilebilir.

Bu proje MLOps'un temellerini ogretir — sadece model egitmek degil, modeli production'da guvenle calistirmak, monitor etmek ve gerektiginde otomatik olarak yeniden egitmek. Mulakatlarda 'ML modeli nasil production'a alirsiniz?' sorusuna pratik deneyimle cevap vereceksin.

architecture.overview: Platform, mikro-servis benzeri bir mimaride tasarlanmis. FastAPI ana API gateway, Celery ile asenkron pipeline orchestration, MLflow ile experiment tracking ve model registry, Redis ile job queue management, PostgreSQL ile metadata storage saglaniyor.

decisions.reasoning: MLflow acik kaynak, vendor-agnostic ve kapsamli: experiment tracking, model registry, model serving hep bir arada. Buyuk cloud vendor'lara bagimli kalmadan MLOps yapabilirsin.
decisions.alternatives: Weights & Biases, Neptune.ai, ClearML, kendi cozumun
decisions.when_to_choose_alternative: W&B gorsel dashboard'u cok iyi — takim collaboration onemli ise tercih et. Kendi cozumun sadece cok basit ihtiyaclar icin.

decisions.reasoning: Model training uzun sureli islem — API request icinde yapilamaz. Celery distributed task queue olarak training, evaluation ve feature engineering job'larini asenkron calistirir. Redis hem message broker hem result backend.
decisions.when_to_choose_alternative: Basit job queue icin RQ yeter. Karmasik DAG orchestration icin Airflow/Prefect daha uygun.

decisions.reasoning: Feature engineering'i model training'den ayirmak feature reuse saglar. Ayni feature'lari farkli modellerde kullanabilirsin. Online (real-time) ve offline (batch) feature serving farki onemli.
decisions.alternatives: Feature'lari model icinde hesaplamak, Feast, Tecton
decisions.when_to_choose_alternative: Az feature ve tek model varsa ayri store gereksiz. Buyuk olcekte Feast veya Tecton kullan.

technical: MLflow experiment tracking ve model registry
ai_specific: Data drift ve model drift detection

functional: Model training job'u baslatma ve takip etme
ai_requirements: En az 3 farkli model tipi desteklemeli

evaluation_criteria.description: End-to-end pipeline calisiyor mu? Data -> Training -> Serving akisi tam mi?
Experiment tracking, model registry dogru kullaniliyor mu?
Model ve data drift tespit ediliyor mu?

milestones.title: Proje Altyapisi & Veri Pipeline Tasarimi
milestones.overview: Proje yapisini kur, veritabani semaalarini olustur, veri yukleme ve temizleme pipeline'ini implement et.

steps.title: Proje Yapisi & Docker Setup
steps.why: ML projeleri cok bilesenden olusur — temiz yapi bastan sart.
steps.instructions: FastAPI + Celery + MLflow + PostgreSQL + Redis icin docker-compose olustur. Her servis ayri container.
steps.code_snippet:
# Proje yapisi
/api          # FastAPI app
/workers      # Celery workers
/ml           # ML pipeline modules
/features     # Feature engineering
/monitoring   # Drift detection
/frontend     # React dashboard
steps.checkpoint: docker-compose up ile tum servisler calisiyor mu?

steps.title: Veri Ingestion Pipeline
steps.why: ML pipeline'in ilk adimi veriyi guvenli sekilde sisteme almak.
steps.instructions: CSV/JSON upload endpoint'i olustur. Pydantic ile sema validasyonu. Buyuk dosyalar icin streaming upload. Veri profiling (column types, missing values, distributions).
steps.checkpoint: CSV yukleyip veri profili goruntuleniyor mu?

steps.title: Data Validation & Cleaning
steps.why: Garbage in = garbage out. Model kalitesi veri kalitesine baglidir.
steps.instructions:
Otomatik veri temizleme:
1. Missing value handling (drop, mean, median, mode)
2. Outlier detection (IQR, Z-score)
3. Type inference ve conversion
4. Data quality score hesaplama
steps.checkpoint: Eksik degerli ve outlier'li veri setinde temizleme dogru calisiyor mu?

steps.title: Dataset Versioning
steps.why: Hangi modelin hangi veri ile egitildigini bilmek reproducibility icin kritik.
steps.instructions: Her yuklenen dataset'e versiyon ata. Metadata kaydet: boyut, column sayisi, tarih, quality score. Dataset compare ozeligi.
steps.checkpoint: Ayni dataset'in 2 versiyonunu karsilastirabiliyor musun?

milestones.must_note:
📝 Bunu Kesinlikle Not Al:
1. Veri validasyonu ONCE yap, training SONRA — kirli veri ile model egitme
2. Dataset versioning model reproducibility icin ZORUNLU
3. Pydantic schema'lari hem API validasyonu hem veri validasyonu icin kullan
4. Buyuk veri setleri icin streaming upload kullan — RAM'i patlatma
milestones.senior_learns:
🎩 Senior/CTO Boyle Ogrenir:
Data quality ML basarisinin %80'ini belirler. Model algoritmasi degistirmekten once veri kalitesini iyilestir. Data profiling otomatik olmali — her upload'da calistiR.

Production'da data contract'lar kullan: schema degisirse pipeline durur, alert atar. Schema drift = potansiyel model failure.

milestones.title: Feature Engineering & Feature Store
milestones.overview: Reusable feature'lar olustur, feature store pattern'ini implement et, online ve offline serving ayir.

steps.title: Feature Transformer Pipeline
steps.why: Feature engineering'i tekrarlanabilir ve test edilebilir yapmak icin pipeline pattern sart.
steps.instructions:
scikit-learn Pipeline + ColumnTransformer:
1. Numeric: StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler
2. Categorical: OneHotEncoder, LabelEncoder
3. Text: TF-IDF, CountVectorizer
4. Custom transformer'lar
steps.code_snippet:
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ('num', StandardScaler(), numeric_cols),
    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(), categorical_cols),
    ('text', TfidfVectorizer(), text_col)
])

pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('preprocessor', preprocessor),
    ('model', model)
])
steps.checkpoint: Pipeline fit_transform dogru calisiyor mu? Farkli column tipleri dogru handle ediliyor mu?

steps.title: Feature Store Implementation
steps.why: Feature'lari merkezi depoda tutmak reuse saglar ve training-serving skew'u onler.
steps.instructions:
Feature store:
1. Feature tanimlari (isim, tip, transform)
2. Feature hesaplama (batch mode)
3. Feature versioning
4. Feature lineage (hangi raw data'dan geldi)
steps.checkpoint: Ayni feature'i 2 farkli modelde kullanabiliyor musun?

steps.title: Feature Importance & Selection
steps.why: Cok feature = overfitting riski + yavas inference. Onemli feature'lari secmek model kalitesini arttirir.
steps.instructions:
Feature analizi:
1. Correlation matrix
2. Feature importance (tree-based)
3. Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE)
4. Sonuclari dashboard'da goster
steps.checkpoint: Feature importance grafigi cikariyor mu?

milestones.must_note:
📝 Bunu Kesinlikle Not Al:
1. Training-serving skew en buyuk MLOps sorunu — ayni transform'u ikisinde de kullan
2. Feature pipeline'ini SERIALIZE et (pickle/joblib) ve model ile birlikte kaydet
3. Feature store'da metadata ZORUNLU: ne zaman hesaplandi, hangi kaynak, hangi transform
4. One-hot encoding sonrasi boyut patlamasina dikkat — high cardinality'de target encoding kullan
milestones.senior_learns:
🎩 Senior/CTO Boyle Ogrenir:
Feature store buyuk takimlarda en onemli MLOps bilesenlerinden biri. Data scientist A'nin olusturdugu feature'i Data scientist B tekrar hesaplamak zorunda kalmamali.

Online (real-time) vs offline (batch) feature serving farki: online = Redis'ten milisaniyede oku, offline = batch job ile hesapla. Ikisinin tutarli olmasi sart.

milestones.title: Model Training Pipeline & MLflow Entegrasyonu
milestones.overview: Celery ile asenkron model training, MLflow ile experiment tracking ve model karsilastirma.

steps.title: Celery Training Worker
steps.why: Model egitimi dakikalar surer — API request icinde yapilamaz. Asenkron worker ile training job'lari arka planda calisir.
steps.instructions:
Celery worker:
1. Training task tanimla
2. Progress reporting (epoch/step bazli)
3. Cancellation support
4. Error handling ve retry
5. Result storage
steps.code_snippet:
@celery_app.task(bind=True)
def train_model(self, config: dict):
    self.update_state(state='TRAINING', meta={'progress': 0})
    
    with mlflow.start_run():
        mlflow.log_params(config)
        model = train(config)
        mlflow.log_metrics(metrics)
        mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, 'model')
    
    self.update_state(state='COMPLETED', meta={'progress': 100})
steps.checkpoint: Training job'u baslatip progress'i takip edebiliyor musun?

steps.title: MLflow Experiment Tracking
steps.why: Her experiment'in parametrelerini, metriklerini ve artifact'larini kaydetmek model secimi ve karsilastirmasi icin sart.
steps.instructions:
MLflow entegrasyonu:
1. Experiment olustur
2. Her run'da: parametreler, metrikler, modeli logla
3. Artifact'lar: confusion matrix, feature importance plot
4. Tag'ler: model tipi, dataset versiyonu
5. Frontend'de experiment comparison
steps.checkpoint: MLflow UI'da experiment'leri karsilastirabiliyormusun?

steps.title: Hyperparameter Optimization
steps.why: Model performansi hyperparameter secimine baglidir. Otomatik search manual denemeden cok daha etkili.
steps.instructions:
Hyperparameter search:
1. Grid search (az parametre)
2. Random search (cok parametre)
3. Her denemeyi MLflow'a logla
4. En iyi modeli otomatik sec
5. Search space ve strategy konfigurasyonu
steps.checkpoint: Random search ile 10 deneme yapip en iyisini seciyor mu?

steps.title: Model Registry & Versioning
steps.why: Production'daki modelin hangi versiyon oldugunu bilmek ve kolayca rollback yapabilmek icin model registry sart.
steps.instructions:
MLflow Model Registry:
1. Model kaydi (isim, versiyon, stage)
2. Stage transitions: Staging -> Production -> Archived
3. Model metadata: training config, dataset, metrics
4. Model approval workflow
5. API ile model yukle
steps.checkpoint: Modeli Staging'den Production'a gecirebildin mi?

milestones.must_note:
📝 Bunu Kesinlikle Not Al:
1. HER experiment'i logla — 'sonra loglarim' dersen unutursun
2. Model artifact'inda feature pipeline'i da kaydet — yoksa inference'da transform uyusmazligi olur
3. Hyperparameter search'te budget limit koy — sinirsiz arama kaynak israf eder
4. Model Registry'de approval zorunlulugu koy — test edilmemis model production'a cikmasin
milestones.senior_learns:
🎩 Senior/CTO Boyle Ogrenir:
MLflow experiment tracking sadece Data Scientist icin degil. Product Manager'a 'son 10 denemede accuracy %3 artti' gostermek buyuk etki yapar.

Model Registry governance onemli: kim promote edebilir? Hangi testlerden gecmeli? CI/CD ile model validation otomatiklestir.

milestones.title: Model Serving & API Gateway
milestones.overview: Egitilmis modeli real-time inference icin API olarak sun. Batch prediction destegi ekle.

steps.title: Real-time Inference API
steps.why: Modeli API olarak sunmak diger sistemlerin kullanmasini saglar.
steps.instructions:
FastAPI inference endpoint:
1. Model registry'den aktif modeli yukle
2. Input validasyonu (Pydantic)
3. Feature transform uygula
4. Prediction yap ve dondur
5. Response'a confidence score ekle
steps.code_snippet:
@app.post('/api/predict')
async def predict(request: PredictionRequest):
    model = load_production_model()
    features = transform_input(request.data)
    prediction = model.predict(features)
    probability = model.predict_proba(features)
    return {
        'prediction': prediction[0],
        'confidence': float(max(probability[0])),
        'model_version': model.version
    }
steps.checkpoint: API'ya istek gonderip dogru prediction aliyor musun?

steps.title: Model Caching & Warmup
steps.why: Her istekte modeli diskten yuklemek yavas. Cache'te tutmak latency'i dramatik dusurur.
steps.instructions:
Model cache:
1. Startup'ta modeli memory'ye yukle
2. Model degistiginde cache invalidation
3. Lazy loading: ilk istek geldiginde yukle
4. Multiple model version support
steps.checkpoint: Ilk istekten sonra inference latency < 50ms mi?

steps.title: Batch Prediction Endpoint
steps.why: Buyuk veri setleri icin tek tek prediction yapmak verimsiz. Batch endpoint toplu isleme saglar.
steps.instructions:
Batch prediction:
1. CSV upload ile toplu prediction
2. Celery worker'da calistir
3. Sonuclari indirilebilir CSV olarak sun
4. Progress tracking
steps.checkpoint: 1000 satirlik CSV ile batch prediction calisiyor mu?

steps.title: A/B Testing Framework
steps.why: Yeni modelin eskisinden iyi oldugunu production'da test etmek gerekir.
steps.instructions:
A/B testing:
1. Traffic split (% bazli)
2. Her model version'a giden istekleri logla
3. Metric karsilastirma (accuracy, latency)
4. Otomatik winner selection
steps.checkpoint: Trafik %80/%20 bolunup iki model karsilastiriliyor mu?

milestones.must_note:
📝 Bunu Kesinlikle Not Al:
1. Model serving'de input validation ZORUNLU — production'da beklenmedik input gelir
2. Model cache invalidation dogru calismali — eski model ile prediction yapmak tehlikeli
3. A/B test sonuclarinda istatistiksel anlamlilik kontrol et — az veri ile karar verme
4. Inference latency'yi MONITOR et — model buyurse latency artar
milestones.senior_learns:
🎩 Senior/CTO Boyle Ogrenir:
Model serving iki kategori: real-time (< 100ms, API) ve batch (dakikalar, job). Ikisi farkli altyapi gerektirir. Cogu ML sistemi ikisine de ihtiyac duyar.

Shadow deployment: yeni modeli production trafige maruz birak ama sonuclari kullanma — sadece logla ve compare et. En guvenli deployment stratejisi.

milestones.title: Monitoring, Drift Detection & Auto-retraining
milestones.overview: Model performansini surekli izle. Data ve model drift tespit et. Gerektiginde otomatik retraining tetikle.

steps.title: Prediction Logging & Monitoring
steps.why: Production'daki model performansini bilmeden iyilestirme yapamazsin.
steps.instructions:
Her prediction icin logla:
1. Input features
2. Prediction + confidence
3. Latency
4. Model version
5. Timestamp

Dashboard'da goster: avg confidence, prediction distribution, latency percentiles
steps.checkpoint: Son 1 saatin prediction istatistikleri gorunuyor mu?

steps.title: Data Drift Detection
steps.why: Input veri dagilimai degisirse model yanlis prediction yapar. Erken tespit etmek kritik.
steps.instructions:
Data drift:
1. Training data distribution'ini baseline olarak kaydet
2. Production input'larinin dagilimini hesapla
3. KS test veya PSI ile drift olc
4. Feature bazinda drift raporu
5. Threshold asildiginda alert
steps.checkpoint: Dagilimi degistirmis veri ile drift algilaniyor mu?

steps.title: Model Performance Degradation
steps.why: Model accuracy zamanla duser (concept drift). Ground truth geldikce performansi karsilastir.
steps.instructions:
Model drift:
1. Ground truth (gercek sonuclar) toplama mekanizmasi
2. Periyodik accuracy hesaplama
3. Baseline accuracy ile karsilastir
4. Performance drop alert
5. Trend grafigi
steps.checkpoint: Accuracy dustugunde alert tetikleniyor mu?

steps.title: Auto-retraining Pipeline
steps.why: Drift tespit edildiginde modeli otomatik yeniden egitmek downtime'i minimuma indirir.
steps.instructions:
Auto-retraining:
1. Drift alert -> retraining trigger
2. Son N gunun verisi ile yeni model egit
3. Yeni modeli staging'e kaydet
4. Validation testleri calistir
5. Testler gecerse auto-promote (opsiyonel) veya insan onayi bekle
steps.checkpoint: Drift tetikleyip otomatik yeni model egitiliyor mu?

milestones.must_note:
📝 Bunu Kesinlikle Not Al:
1. Monitoring OLMADAN model deploy etme — kör ucus gibi
2. Data drift != model drift — ikisini ayri olc
3. Auto-retraining'de validation ZORUNLU — yeni model daha kotu olabilir
4. Alert fatigue'a dikkat — cok fazla false alarm durumunda alert'ler ignore edilir
milestones.senior_learns:
🎩 Senior/CTO Boyle Ogrenir:
ML model'leri yazilimdan farkli: kod zamanla bozulmaz ama model bozulur. Verinin dagiliimi degisir, kullanici davranisi degisir. Monitoring olmadan production ML sistemi zaman bombasi.

Monitoring maliyeti: her prediction'i loglamak storage maliyeti getirir. Sampling stratejisi kullan — her prediction degil, her 10. veya 100. prediction'i logla.

steps.why: Data scientist'lerin experiment'leri goruntulemesi, karsilastirmasi ve yeni training baslatmasi icin UI sart.

Dashboard sayfalari:

steps.title: Monitoring Dashboard
steps.why: Prediction istatistikleri, drift alertleri ve model performansini gozlemlemek operasyonel kararlari bilgilendirir.

Monitoring goruntuleri:

4. Active alerts ve alert gecmisi
steps.checkpoint: Drift gerceklestiginde dashboard'da gorunuyor mu?

steps.title: Docker & Production Config
steps.why: Tum bilesenleri container olarak paketlemek deployment tutarliligini saglar.
steps.instructions:
Production:
1. Multi-stage Dockerfile (API, worker, frontend)
2. docker-compose.prod.yml
3. Health checks (her servis)
4. Environment variables (.env)
5. Volume mounts (model artifacts, data)
steps.checkpoint: docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up ile her sey calisiyor mu?

steps.title: Model Card & Documentation
steps.why: Her modelin ne yaptigi, limitasyonlari ve kullanim kilavuzu dokumante edilmeli.
steps.instructions:
Model card sablonu:
1. Model amaci ve kapsam
2. Training data aciklamasi
3. Performance metrikleri
4. Limitasyonlar ve bias'lar
5. Kullanim talimatlari
6. Versiyon gecmisi
steps.checkpoint: Her model icin model card olusturulmus mu?

milestones.must_note:
📝 Bunu Kesinlikle Not Al:
1. Dashboard'da 'Deploy to Production' butonu koymadan once approval workflow kur
2. Docker volume mount'lari dogru yapilandir — model artifact'lari kaybolmasin
3. Model card yazmak sikici ama ZORUNLU — regulatory compliance icin gerekebilir
4. Health check'ler sadece 200 donmemeli — model'in yuklu oldugunu da dogrulamali
milestones.senior_learns:
🎩 Senior/CTO Boyle Ogrenir:
MLOps maturity model: Level 0 (manual), Level 1 (ML pipeline automation), Level 2 (CI/CD for ML). Bu projede Level 1'e ulasiyorsun. Level 2 icin model validation testleri CI/CD pipeline'ina entegre et.

Model card kavrami Google'dan geliyor. Responsible AI icin her modelin limitasyonlarini ve bias'larini dokumante etmek artik industry standard.

github_guidance.daily_commit_target: Günde en az 3-5 anlamlı commit. Contribution graph'ın yeşil kalması önemli.
pro_tips: MLflow experiment sonuclarini README'de tablo olarak goster (model tipi, accuracy, F1, training suresi) — somut metrikler recruiter'i etkiler.
Drift detection icin gercek bir senaryo olustur: baseline veri ile egit, dagiliimi degistirmis veri ile test et, sonuclari README'ye ekle.
Feature store pattern'ini ayri bir modül olarak tasarla ve README'de 'training-serving skew prevention' bolumu yaz — bu MLOps olgunlugunu gosterir.
Auto-retraining pipeline'inin akis diyagramini README'ye koy: drift alert → retrain → validate → promote/reject — end-to-end MLOps anlayisini gosterir.

cover_letter_guidance.project_highlight: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline and model serving platform with MLflow experiment tracking, feature store, A/B testing, drift detection, and auto-retraining, achieving <100ms p95 inference latency and automated model lifecycle management from data ingestion to production deployment.
talking_points: Architected end-to-end MLOps pipeline covering data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, experiment tracking, registry, serving, and monitoring
Implemented real-time inference API with intelligent model caching achieving <50ms latency after warmup and batch prediction support for 1000+ records
Built data drift detection using Kolmogorov-Smirnov test and PSI metrics with automated retraining triggers and validation guardrails
Designed A/B testing framework with traffic splitting and statistical significance testing for safe production model rollouts
Tracked 50+ experiments with MLflow including hyperparameter optimization, model comparison, and automated stage promotion (Staging → Production → Archived)

planning.prompt_template: I'm building an end-to-end ML pipeline and model serving platform using FastAPI, React + TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MLflow, scikit-learn, Celery + Redis for async task processing, and Docker. Help me design the system architecture considering: data ingestion and validation pipeline, feature engineering with scikit-learn Pipeline/ColumnTransformer, feature store design, Celery worker for async model training, MLflow experiment tracking and model registry, real-time inference API with model caching, A/B testing framework, data drift detection (KS test, PSI), auto-retraining triggers, and monitoring dashboard.
planning.when_to_use: Her milestone'un basinda kullan — ML pipeline mimarisi, feature store tasarimi ve MLOps workflow planlamak icin

code_review.prompt_template: Review this MLOps platform code (FastAPI + MLflow + scikit-learn + Celery + Redis) for: data validation and cleaning pipeline robustness, scikit-learn Pipeline serialization for training-serving consistency, MLflow experiment logging completeness, Celery task error handling and retry logic, model serving API input validation and caching, A/B testing statistical significance, drift detection threshold calibration, auto-retraining safety guardrails, and Docker multi-service health checks.
code_review.when_to_use: Her step tamamlandiktan sonra kullan — ozellikle feature pipeline, MLflow entegrasyonu ve drift detection mantigi icin

debugging.prompt_template: I'm getting this error in my ML pipeline platform (FastAPI + MLflow + scikit-learn + Celery + Redis + PostgreSQL): [error]. The relevant code is: [code]. Pipeline config: [config]. I'm trying to [goal].
debugging.when_to_use: 15 dakikadan fazla takildiginda kullan — ozellikle MLflow logging hatalari, scikit-learn pipeline uyumsuzluklari, Celery task failure'lari ve model serving latency sorunlari icin

research.prompt_template: Explain [concept] with practical examples for an MLOps pipeline platform. Topics I need help with: MLflow experiment tracking and model registry API, scikit-learn Pipeline and ColumnTransformer, feature store design patterns, Celery distributed task queue with Redis, Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for data drift, Population Stability Index (PSI), A/B testing with statistical significance, model serving best practices (caching, warmup), hyperparameter optimization (grid/random search), and Docker volume management for ML artifacts.
research.when_to_use: Yeni bir MLOps konsepti ogrenirken kullan — ozellikle MLflow, drift detection, feature engineering ve model serving icin
